description: S59 T6 (EV7, EV8): secretref.check answers whether the reference WOULD resolve, and never what it resolves to. Two booleans plus the refusal's kind and sentence; the value is read (or not) inside the resolver and dropped on the floor, so a check that could leak is not a check the daemon can offer. sourcePresent:false is the diagnostic that matters — the variable is unset, the file is not there, or the credential record was deleted.

result.name: deploy-token
result.refusalSentence: refused: secret-unresolvable · the daemon's environment has no DEPLOY_TOKEN to read · do: set it in the daemon's environment, or point the reference at a key file or a stored credential
